# hivelocity_device_ipmi (Data Source)

Returns IPMI controller information and current sensor readings of a device.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hivelocity_device_ipmi" "web" {
  device_id = 12345
}

output "web_temperatures" {
  value = [for s in data.hivelocity_device_ipmi.web.sensors : s if s.group == "Temperature"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device_id` (Number) ID of the device.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `info` (Map of String) IPMI controller details (firmware revision, manufacturer, ...).
- `sensors` (List of Object) Sensor readings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sensors))

<a id="nestedatt--sensors"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sensors`

Read-Only:

- `group` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `reading` (Number)
- `sensor_id` (String)
- `status` (Boolean)
- `units` (String)
